cards.name: hero
cards.question: Free Tool
cards.qualifier: Bold your Discord display name, custom status, role or channel names with 9 Unicode bold styles, and learn when markdown is the better way to bold.

groups.label: Why it pastes as bold
groups.text: Each style is a different set of Unicode characters that happen to look heavy.

groups.label: When markdown is the right choice
groups.text: For anything inside a message, markdown is better.

groups.label: When you need Unicode bold
groups.text: Markdown isn't rendered in your display name.
